<!-- pr-reviewer: 4d415110b9fe25e776e68168317f54da2d369298 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** The trial merge with the current `main` is clean. The conflict resolutions keep both sides, and they lose no refusal or safety rule. The code delta is the Finish3D "Do not touch" behavior. The touched app suites pass.

This is a P3 refresh review. The diff keeps the full-tool guard of Finish3D clear of protected faces and edges, and it refuses a remaining contact by name.

## What looks good

- The conflict union is complete at `crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs:55`: `Offset2D | Pocket3D | Trace | Finish3D | Face`. The refusal text at `avoid.rs:65` names all five kinds.
- `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:51` and `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` give the same five kinds. They agree with each other.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch.rs` keeps both `finish3d_shows_pick_protected_button` and `face_op_shows_pick_protected_button`. The unsupported-text assertion matches the merged text.
- `finish_centre_area` (`crates/app/src/operation/avoid.rs:250`) projects the full-tool keep-out from the cut bottom to the clearance plane, with `AVOID_PAD`. It subtracts the keep-out from the cutter-centre area and reuses `finish_clip::clip_path`. A disjoint keep-out returns the original clip, so unprotected moves do not change.
- The inverse yaw is correct. A tilted (3+2) operation never also gets a WCS yaw (`crates/app/src/operation/wcs_yaw.rs:172`). So the keep-out and the cut are always in the same frame.
- The final guard (`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:3490` -> `avoid.rs:281` `protect_path`) runs after the WCS restore and after fixture routing. It raises upright rapid links, else refuses a remaining contact by name. A refusal returns `Err`, so the path does not post. The post gate (`crates/app/src/posting.rs:995` -> `live_avoid_problems`) now covers Finish3D too.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!()` in the new production code (the app production diff has none).
- Process: the body ends `Fixes #3347`, it has a `Changelog:` line, the commit subjects are conventional. No `CHANGELOG.md`, snapshot PNG, dependency or process-file change. The decision record is present.

## Results (merged with `main`)

Trial merge: I merged the current `origin/main` `44c13a01d` into head `4d415110b`. The merge was automatic, with no conflict. The only new `main` content is #3676 (sim preview march and `trace.wgsl`), and it merged cleanly. The parent #3462 is already MERGED, so the "merge #3462 first" condition is met and this PR's delta is purely the Finish3D change.

Local, `-j 3`, on the trial-merged tree:

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test do_not_touch` | 5 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test do_not_touch_finish3d` | 5 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test do_not_touch_face` | 3 passed, 0 failed |
| app test binaries compile (`--no-run`) | clean, exit 0 |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- do_not_touch` | **not run by this reviewer** - the clean build of the ui lib was still compiling at post time |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | not run by this reviewer |

The author's reading on this exact head is 9/9 for the ui `do_not_touch` tests and clean clippy. The earlier reviewer read 8/8 on `f7ff1d080`, and the production code did not change since then. I did not confirm those two steps on this head myself, so I do not count them as a pass.

## Targeted tests

- The diff touches no post or toolpath output beyond the Finish3D guard. The app `do_not_touch_finish3d` pins ran (5/5), including the named refusal and blocked post.
- No heavy lane. The PR is P3, so no heavy step is owed (#3558).

## Requested before merge

None. I found no blocker.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` is 4422 lines, already over the ~400-line guide, and this PR adds 24. AGENTS.md "Code shape" does not block the growth of a file already over, but it is worth a split later.
- The PR is currently a draft. The maintainer flags it ready just before the merge.
- The ui `do_not_touch` lib suite and clippy were not rerun by this reviewer (see above). The author reports both green on this head.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
